label: Stream Management
tagline: Set the live title, category and tags, run ads, and drop markers from chat.
description: Lead moderators edit the live stream from chat the way Nightbot and StreamElements do: !title / !settitle, !game / !setgame, !tags, !commercial / !ad, and !marker. Each command can be toggled on this page. They ship on. Needs a Twitch re-consent for channel:manage:broadcast and channel:edit:commercial if you signed up before those grants existed.

commands.title: Show or set the stream title.
commands.game: Show or set the stream category.
commands.cmd: List commands, or add/edit/remove custom ones.
